title: ANIME WORKOUTS - Can you look like Adam from Record of Ragnarok in real life?
summary: NH designs two time-efficient, low-impact programs to build Adam's slim 'swimmer's physique' from Record of Ragnarok: a 2-day weights template done twice a week and a 4-sessions-per-week bodyweight template. Both emphasize shoulders, lats, chest, arms, forearms, abs and calves, leave legs mostly untrained for athletes' sport work, and suit beginners or people who don't want to get big.
claims: Not everyone wants a freak physique; he respects people aiming for a slimmer beach physique
Adam has an aesthetic 'swimmer's physique': fairly low body fat, good definition, no bulk, unimpressive in a shirt but very appealing by normie standards
The Adam programs focus on shoulders, biceps, abs, forearms, lats, chest and calves and leave the legs and posterior chain mostly undeveloped
If you want lower body growth, follow the Baki program instead; intermediates who want to get big should follow the Tokita Ohma program
Weights template: two days, done only twice a week with at least two rest days between; each session under 1.5 hours with warm-ups, about 3 hours a week

Weights day 1: bench 3x6-10 + DB rows 3x8-12; OHP 3x4-8 + chin-ups (AMRAPx3 bodyweight or 3x5 weighted) + knee raises AMRAPx3; goblet squats 3x6-10 + DB curls 3x8-12 + side planks + calf raises AMRAPx3
Weights day 2: barbell curls 3x6-10 + barbell rows 3x8-12; DB OHP 3x6-10 + pull-ups + leg raises; close-grip bench 3x8-12 + finger curls 3x8-12 + bicycle crunches + calf raises
Supersets may be hard at first because of cardio but you acclimate
A strong V-taper needs lats and shoulders
Calf training is easy and inconsequential to recovery, so do it if you want developed calves
The weights template can be run four times a week, and it is the better option for heavier people wanting to lose fat
Bodyweight template: same two days repeated four times a week, since bodyweight work damages fibers less and calisthenics are more repeatable and less fatiguing
Calisthenics day 1: chin-ups + knee raises; reverse supinated ring rows + goblet squats; false-grip dead hangs + side planks + calf raises
Calisthenics day 2: ring push-ups + reverse snow angels; ring dips + Romanian deadlifts; decline push-ups + V-up crunches + butterfly lateral raises
Finish all sets of one superset pair before starting the next pair
With higher frequency, split muscle groups across days (biceps only day 1, chest only day 2) to avoid stalling or injury
The bodyweight template suits light individuals; it can be frustrating for heavier people
Bodyweight sessions take under an hour, about 50 minutes with good cardio, with 2-3 minutes rest between supersets
Both templates leave legs fresh, so athletes can play a sport alongside; schedule sessions away from sport training
A slim aesthetic physique is easy to maintain, but to keep growing you must graduate to a higher frequency and volume program
exercises: only leg exercise; can be replaced with squats
on belly, mimic snow angel; optional small plates
upper back and delts without weights
